summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_247 voicemail fixes and the eSIM 'unlimited' copy on CloudIVR web. I signed up a fresh account, qa.vmfix1794353540@example.com / QaTest#2026x (dry-run, $0). Playwright faked numbers, audio, audio/tts, campaigns and esim in the browser, so no real TTS ran, no real campaign was created and no eSIM was bought. PASS (1, HIGH): main message is a written script, mode 'script', no voicemail audio made → inline error 'Create the voicemail audio first, or pick another option.' and ZERO requests (no validateOnly, no TTS). The main ScriptBox stays open. Mode 'other' with no clip → 'Pick the clip to leave on voicemail…' and zero requests. PASS (2, MEDIUM): after Make AI voice on the main script (TTS → mainA), the ScriptBox closes. 'Start from my call script' still shows and fills 'Hi, this is Acme. Your bill is due Friday. Please call us back at your earliest convenience. Thank you.' (the Press 1 sentence is dropped; 19 words · about 8 seconds). PASS (3, LOW): the voicemail TTS (name 'Campaign · voicemail') shows campaign-vm-script-preview and campaign-vm-script-ready. Typing in the text removes both. The old voice-preview is not rendered. After remaking the voicemail audio, Save sent one POST /campaigns with audioId=mainA and voicemailAudioId=vm1, then went to the detail page. PASS (4): FR and ES pill and banner are fully translated with correct plural grammar. FR: '12 personnes qui n’ont pas décroché entendront « Promo » plus tard. 80% des 15 messages dans la messagerie vocale atteints.' ES: '12 personas que no contestaron escucharán “Promo” más tarde. 80% de los 15 buzones de voz alcanzados.' The singular forms (Quelqu’un qui n’a pas décroché… / Alguien que no contestó…) are correct. PASS (5): the light-theme pill is green when >0 (rgb(21,128,61) on a 15% green background) and neutral when 0. FAIL: in the DARK theme the pill text and the banner count stay rgb(21,128,61), dark green on near-black, which is low contrast. The `dark:` Tailwind variants never apply (details in RCA). PASS (6): the /app/esim plan card shows 'Unlimited data · Unlimited calls · Unlimited texts' in EN, FR ('Données/Appels/SMS illimités') and ES ('Datos/Llamadas/Mensajes ilimitados'). It shows no MB/GB/minutes, even though the mocked plan had data 1GB and voiceMinutes 100. An owned active eSIM shows no 'This cycle' line, even though the mocked usage returned a 0.5 GB / 100 min allowance. NOT VERIFIABLE: landing/EsimPlans.js is not imported or rendered anywhere, so its Unlimited bullets never show. The public landing eSIM hero card (ESIM_POINTS) shows no allowances, but it doesn't say 'unlimited' either. The preview /public/esim-plans list is empty.

ui_bugs.component: Campaign list pill + detail banner + RECOMMENDED tag + vm-script-ready (dark theme)
ui_bugs.issue: The dark-theme colour classes (`dark:!text-[#4ade80]`, `dark:text-[#4ade80]`) never apply. tailwind.config uses darkMode:['class'], but theme.js sets html[data-civr-theme='dark'] and never adds a `.dark` class. In dark mode, the pill and the large '📩 12 voicemails left' banner count show #15803d (dark green) on a near-black card, which is hard to read (measured rgb(21,128,61) in dark mode).

The inline error stays on screen after the user switches the voicemail option. Example: the 'Pick the clip to leave on voicemail…' error is still shown after choosing 'Write a voicemail script' or 'Leave my message'. Clear the error in onMode.

issues: 'voicemails left' means messages that were left (deposited). FR 'messages … restants' and ES 'buzones de voz pendientes' mean 'remaining' or 'pending', which reads as if they still have to be sent. Better: FR '📩 12 messages vocaux laissés', ES '📩 12 mensajes de voz dejados'. The ES stats grid already uses 'Mensajes dejados'.

FR '3 messages dans la messagerie vocale jusqu'à présent — …' is missing the word for 'reached' (atteints/joints) and uses a straight apostrophe. Suggest '3 messageries vocales atteintes jusqu’à présent — …'.
FR 'messages dans la messagerie vocale' is long for a small pill. 'messages vocaux' is shorter.

EsimPlans.js (with the Unlimited bullets) is dead code: nothing imports it. If the owner wants 'unlimited' shown publicly, add 'Unlimited data, calls and texts' to ESIM_POINTS (ProductHero.js), which is what the landing hero card actually renders.

action_items: Fix the dark-theme colours. Either make theme.js toggle a `.dark` class on <html> together with data-civr-theme, or set tailwind darkMode to ['variant', '&:is([data-civr-theme="dark"] *)']. Or replace the `dark:` classes in Campaigns.js:53/153, CampaignDetail.js:25 and VoicemailScript.js:32 with CSS keyed on html[data-civr-theme='dark'].
Change the FR/ES pill and banner keys from 'remaining/pending' to 'left/deposited' (laissés / dejados), and fix the FR 'reached so far' string
Clear the create error when vmMode changes
Decide on the public landing: either mount EsimPlans or add the Unlimited copy to ESIM_POINTS. Right now EsimPlans.js is unused.
Delete the test account qa.vmfix1794353540@example.com (and qa.vmscript1794352808@example.com from iteration_247 if it is still there)
critical_code_review_comments: Esim.js UsageLine: it still runs useApi(`/esim/${id}/usage`) for every active line, then always returns null, and the code after `return null` can never run. That is a wasted provider request on each render and dead code. Remove the component, or at least the fetch.
Esim.js PlanCard and EsimCheckout show p.label/p.name from the catalog. If the owner names a plan like 'T-Mobile 5GB', the allowance shows up again. Consider a backend guard or a note to the owner.
Campaigns.js:239 madeTexts only keeps texts made in this page session. That is fine for the flow, but a library clip picked later still has no text (expected).

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (every requested retest passes; the dark-theme pill/banner contrast fails; the landing EsimPlans section could not be verified because it is not rendered)

seed_data_creation: One sign-up account only. All numbers, audio, TTS, campaigns and eSIM calls were faked in the browser.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is at /cloudivr/login. Click cookie-allow-all first. Use one page.route('**/api/cloudivr-web/**') that dispatches by path and returns route.continue_() for everything else. TTS mock: 'Please call us back' in the body → vm1, otherwise mainA. The main ScriptBox Make button is campaign-script-voice-make, the voicemail one is campaign-vm-script-voice-make. Theme: topbar-account-menu > topbar-theme-button > topbar-theme-{light|dark}. Language: topbar-account-menu > topbar-lang-switcher > topbar-lang-switcher-option-{en|fr|es}. To test the eSIM page, mock GET /esim with {plans, items}, plus /esim/{id}/usage and /esim/{id}/qr. The eSIM plan card testid is esim-plan-<planId without non-word chars>.
rca of the issue: Dark-theme contrast: frontend/tailwind.config.js has darkMode:['class']. cloudivr/theme.js only sets the data-civr-theme attribute on <html> and never adds a 'dark' class, so every `dark:` utility in CloudIVR is inert. Repro: Account menu → Appearance → Dark, then open Campaigns with a campaign whose stats.voicemailLeft is greater than 0. The pill colour stays rgb(21,128,61). Fix: change the darkMode selector, or toggle a .dark class.
